key_fiscal_facts.value_text: Variable by state/territory: 10-12.5% onshore; offshore federal = no royalty (PRRT replaces it); North West Shelf 10-12.5% legacy royalty

0% state equity participation. Australia uses fiscal (PRRT + CIT) model exclusively for offshore. No NOC with upstream equity in PRRT-governed offshore. NOPSEMA (National Offshore Petroleum Safety and Environmental Management Authority) is regulatory body only.
